title: Local Allow, Global Deny: Why Per-Action Authorization Does Not Compose in LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.27620v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autonomous LLM agents act through tools under per-action authorization: a local guard screens each tool call in isolation. We show that local authorization does not compose into global authorization. A compositional authorization failure (CAF) is a locally authorized execution, or a pair of locally authorized executions, that violates a global policy spanning intent, purpose, provenance, consent, and delegation. We characterize CAFs along two axes, expressiveness (single-trace safety versus relational k-safety) and observability (a ladder of monitor profiles). Our central result is an impossibility: relational purpose violations form a 2-safety hyperproperty with no per-trace locus of blame, so a per-action monitor that never raises a false alarm detects none of them, independent of the underlying model or decision procedure; they become visible only under cross-execution monitoring, which none of the six guardrails we survey implement

translated_title: 局部允许，全局拒绝：为什么逐操作授权在LLM智能体中无法组合
translated_abstract: 自主LLM智能体通过工具在逐操作授权机制下执行动作：本地守卫将每次工具调用隔离地筛查。我们证明，本地授权无法组合成全局授权。组合授权失败（CAF）是指某个本地授权的执行，或一对本地授权的执行，违反了跨越意图、目的、来源、同意和委托的全局策略。我们沿两个维度对CAF进行刻画：表达能力（单轨迹安全性与关系k-安全性）和可观测性（监视器配置的阶梯）。我们的核心结果是一个不可能性定理：关系目的违规构成一种2-安全超属性，不存在单轨迹层面的归因位置，因此从不误报的逐操作监视器无法检测到任何此类违规，且该结论与底层模型或决策程序无关；此类违规只有在跨执行监视下才会显现，而我们调研的六种防护措施均未实现这一点。
tldr: 论文证明了LLM智能体的逐操作本地授权在原理上无法组合成全局授权——关系目的违规属于无单轨迹归因的2-安全超属性，因此从不误报的逐操作监视器必然检测不到这类违规，唯有跨执行监视才能揭示它们。
